requirement:
The model-facing search and `finish_search` tool descriptions MUST give the
same selection guidance as
{cite}`requirements.authoring.search_accounting.instructions`.
rationale:
**Obligation.** `requirements.authoring.finish_search.description` says the model-facing search and `finish_search` tool descriptions must give the same selection guidance as `requirements.authoring.search_accounting.instructions`. That guidance has four parts:
- Include a tag only when its snippet information was used to justify the conclusion without an additional source read.
- Entries whose source was read may be omitted, and including them is harmless.
- Use `used:[]` when no entries qualify, including for an empty search.
- Close every delivered search before submitting. `finish_search` records dependencies and does not request more source.

The search tools that deliver snippets are `ripgrep` and `ast_grep`. These are the "search" descriptions the requirement covers.

**Test.** `src/authoring/tools.rs#mod[tests]/fn[finish_search_advertises_the_accounting_schema_and_selection_rule]` carries the `{test}` reference to the subject.
- For `finish_search`, it looks up the tool in `definitions()` and asserts that its description contains these phrases:
  - "snippets you used to justify your conclusion without an additional source read"
  - "Entries whose source you also read may be omitted; including them is harmless"
  - "Use used:[] when no entries qualify, including an empty search"
  - "Every delivered search must be finished before submission"
  - "no additional source is delivered"
  - the result form and an example call
- For both `ripgrep` and `ast_grep`, it asserts that each description contains these phrases:
  - "tags whose snippets you used to justify your conclusion without an additional source read"
  - "Entries whose source you also read may be omitted; including them is harmless"
  - "Use an empty used list if no entries qualify"
  - "Before submitting, call finish_search"

**Mapping.**
- The "used to justify without an additional source read" criterion is asserted in all three descriptions.
- The "read entries may be omitted, including them harmless" clause is asserted in all three.
- The `used:[]` / empty-list clause is asserted in all three.
- The "close every search before submitting" duty is asserted in the `finish_search` description ("Every delivered search must be finished before submission") and in both search descriptions ("Before submitting, call finish_search").
- The "does not request more source" clause is asserted in the `finish_search` description as "no additional source is delivered". The search descriptions add the related statement that selected items become dependencies without another source read. That statement is not asserted, but the requirement asks for the same selection guidance, not for every sentence.

**Cross-check.** I read `definitions` in `src/authoring/tools.rs`. The actual `ripgrep` and `ast_grep` descriptions contain these phrases, so the assertions check real text. No other search tool exists. `references` and `habeas` are not result-delivering search tools.

**Gaps.** The test uses substring assertions rather than the exact instruction text. The requirement asks for the same guidance, not identical wording, so this is appropriate. A description that dropped or contradicted any of the key selection rules would fail the test. I found no unacknowledged gap and no marking gap.
